citation: H10_Phage: 359 bp N-terminal fragment of a phage minor structural protein, CP001348.1:3379404-3379762. NOT a full-length gene. No EC, no reaction, no metabolite. Authors state mechanism unknown and raise regulatory-RNA / ethanol-tolerance / plating-efficiency as alternatives to any metabolic role. UNRESOLVABLE to an edge -- this row is the whole problem.

H10_BK: CP001348.1:989500-990681, partial. Two beta-ketoacyl synthases (one truncated to a PKS dehydrogenase domain). curated_set: EC 2.3.1.41/2.3.1.179/2.3.1.180 span 164 MNXR, 83 atom-mapped; MNXR115071 is a REPRESENTATIVE of that set, not a curator's pick. Mechanism: drains acetyl-CoA/malonyl-ACP into fatty-acid elongation, competing with acetyl-CoA -> acetaldehyde -> ethanol.

ENV_F1: ~1.1 kb, Hydrogenophaga sp. PBC FR720599.2. NADH:flavin oxidoreductase/NADH oxidase + a cytochrome c-type protein (no EC, electron carrier). curated_set: 13 MNXR over EC 1.5.1.29/1.5.1.38/1.6.99.1/1.6.3.4, 8 atom-mapped. Mechanism: oxidises NADH, the reductant ethanol formation consumes.

ENV_M1: Pedosphaera pavula, NO nucleotide alignment possible -- assignment is BLASTX of reading frames only. Prevent-host-death antitoxin (no metabolic EC) + hypothetical protein + partial ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase. curated_set: 18 MNXR, 16 atom-mapped. Host is an obligate anaerobe with no functioning quinol/cytochrome chain on this medium, so expected unreachable.
